methodologyNotes: Published self-serve USD pricing collected for the 2025 tax year (returns filed in 2026). TurboTax product pages were fetched directly from turbotax.intuit.com and returned live prices. TaxAct pricing was fetched directly from taxact.com and returned live prices ($59.99/$99.99/$109.99 for Deluxe/Premier/Self-Employed; some comparison aggregators show lower promotional figures from earlier in the season). Cash App Taxes pricing was confirmed directly from cash.app/taxes. H&R Block, FreeTaxUSA, and TaxSlayer blocked direct fetches with HTTP 403; their prices were sourced from SmartAsset dedicated per-vendor review pages (smartasset.com), which are corroborated against the SmartAsset tax software comparison page. Tax filing software bills per-return (one-time annual fee), not monthly subscriptions; monthlyUsd reflects the per-filing fee for the smallest available unit (a single federal return). annualDiscountPct is null for all plans because there is no monthly vs. annual billing distinction — all plans are single-season purchases. minutesIncluded, callsIncluded, overagePerMin, and overagePerCall are null throughout (non-telephony product). hipaa and baa are null for all vendors (personal tax filing is not a HIPAA-regulated healthcare context). State filing fees are noted in plan notes but are not included in monthlyUsd since they are per-state add-ons, not the base plan price.

vendors.name: TurboTax
vendors.provenance: https://turbotax.intuit.com/personal-taxes/online/ (official pricing page fetched directly; prices rendered live for 2025 tax year)

plans.name: Free Edition
plans.notes: Federal: $0, State: $0. Simple Form 1040 returns only (W-2 income, standard deduction, earned income/child tax credits, student loan interest). Approximately 37% of filers qualify. Does not cover itemized deductions, self-employment income, investments, or rental property.

plans.name: Deluxe
plans.notes: Federal: $79 (early-season price; standard full price $139 per official site). State additional (~$39-$59 per state, not listed on product page). Covers itemized deductions, mortgage interest, donations, rental income. Pay-when-you-file model.

plans.name: Premium
plans.notes: Federal: $139 (standard price; full price up to $149 per official site). State additional. Formerly called Self-Employed. Covers investments, crypto, rental property, freelance/gig income, Schedule C. Pay-when-you-file model.

plans.name: Live Assisted Deluxe
plans.notes: Federal starts at $89 (range $89-$209 depending on complexity). State additional. Adds on-demand access to credentialed tax experts (avg 12 years experience) and expert final review before filing.

plans.name: Full Service
plans.notes: Starting at $100 federal (includes state). A matched tax expert prepares, reviews, and files the return for you. Final price varies by complexity; shown as 'starting at' — actual price confirmed before expert begins work.

vendors.name: H&R Block
vendors.provenance: https://hrblock.com blocked direct fetch (HTTP 403); pricing sourced from SmartAsset H&R Block dedicated review (smartasset.com/taxes/hr-block-review), corroborated against SmartAsset best-tax-software comparison page. Prices reflect 2025 tax year (2026 filing season).

plans.name: Free Online
plans.notes: Federal: $0, State: $0. Covers W-2 income, standard deduction, earned income credit, child tax credit. Simple returns.

plans.name: Deluxe
plans.notes: Federal: $35, State: $37 per state. Covers itemized deductions including mortgage interest, charitable contributions, and HSA contributions.

plans.name: Premium
plans.notes: Federal: $89, State: $37 per state. Covers investment income, stock sales, rental property income, cryptocurrency. SmartAsset comparison page lists $70; dedicated SmartAsset review page lists $89 — $89 used as the more detailed source.

plans.name: Self-Employed
plans.notes: Federal: $85, State: $37 per state. Covers Schedule C, self-employment income, freelance and gig economy income. Small business owners.

vendors.name: FreeTaxUSA
vendors.provenance: freetaxusa.com and cnbc.com/select blocked direct fetch (HTTP 403); pricing sourced from SmartAsset FreeTaxUSA dedicated review (smartasset.com/taxes/freetaxusa-review). Free federal + $15.99 state and $7.99 Deluxe confirmed across multiple 2026 reviews. Pro Support corrected to $64.99 (current 2026 price per CNBC Select and U.S. News reviews); the SmartAsset-sourced $44.99 was a stale prior-season figure. Prices reflect 2025 tax year (2026 filing).

plans.name: Free (Federal)
plans.notes: Federal: $0 for all return types including self-employed, investments, and complex returns. State: $15.99 per state. Four editions (Basic, Advanced, Premium, Self-Employed) all share identical pricing — the editions differ in UI guidance, not price. Optional Deluxe add-on: $7.99. Optional Pro Support add-on: $44.99.

plans.name: Deluxe Add-On
plans.notes: Optional upgrade on top of Free Federal ($0) + State ($15.99). Adds priority customer support, live chat with tax specialists, and unlimited free amended returns (Form 1040-X).

plans.name: Pro Support Add-On
plans.notes: Optional upgrade on top of Free Federal ($0) + State ($15.99). Includes personal tax advice, phone access to tax experts, and live screen sharing with a tax professional. Verified at $64.99 for the 2026 filing season via CNBC Select and U.S. News FreeTaxUSA reviews; the earlier $44.99 figure was a stale prior-season price.

plans.name: Simply Free
plans.notes: Federal: $0. First state return: $0. Additional states: $39.99 each. Simple W-2 returns only; limited to single filer with no dependents and no itemized deductions. Very restricted eligibility.
